top_signals.title: Chicago, Midwest Under Tornado Threat as Flights are Grounded
top_signals.summary: Severe thunderstorms raked Chicago and the Midwest Tuesday, triggering tornado warnings and disrupting hundreds of flights as another round of dangerous weather swept across the US.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Barclays Sees Picky Bond Buyers Keeping Yields at Multiyear Peak
top_signals.summary: A shift in the buyer base of US Treasuries toward value-oriented mutual funds, households and other private investors has helped propel 30-year yields to multi-decade peaks, according to Barclays Plc.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Nasdaq to acquire LeveL Markets in push toward ‘always-on’ markets
top_signals.summary: Nasdaq’s acquisition of the third-largest US alternative trading system comes as the exchange operator expands into tokenized securities and longer trading hours.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
